title: Tinker Material Table
description: Adds a table for all tinker's construct materials and supports sorting by material stats.
body:
This mod adds a data table for all material in tinker's construct, in order to help players finding the materials with the best stats. After installing this mod, press a key in game (default 'P') to show the table.  
First, choose a material category (head, handle, grip, plating, etc.). All materials that suits the category will be displayed in the table.  
Click on the table headers to sort the materials by that stat.  
![A table of tinker materials and their stats values](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79d22415c061e48eb4d161e4c7cec6eced2812ad.png)

Known Issues:  
Text may not display properly when other tinker's construct addons are present. This will be fixed in a future version.
